name: Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend
description:
Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend is a deck-building roguelike fan game based on Touhou Project.

One day, Kaguya Houraisan of Eientei held the Lunar Capital Exhibition, attracting visitors from far and wide.
But in the midst of the event, its centerpiece—the treasured artifact known as the “Jeweled Branch of Hourai”—was suddenly stolen.

Seeking to resolve the incident, Kaguya made an announcement:
“Find the missing Exhibit, and I shall reward you with one of my treasures.”

Upon hearing this, the residents of Gensokyo rushed to begin their investigations.
Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, Sakuya Izayoi, Cirno, and Koishi Komeiji were no exception.

・Harness your mana and unleash powerful danmaku.

Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend is a deck-building roguelike.
Choose from cards with a wide variety of costs and effects as you advance through each stage.

・Five playable characters, each with two distinct strategies.

The five playable characters are Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, Sakuya Izayoi, Cirno, and Koishi Komeiji.

Each character offers two core strategies.
With entirely different cards and tactics to choose from, find your favorite way to fight.

・Collect Exhibits to grow stronger.

Acquiring Exhibits from the Lunar Capital Exhibition allows you to enhance your character’s abilities.

Gather as many Exhibits as you can along the way and take on the powerful foes standing between you and the true culprit.

・Beautiful visual effects bring every journey to life.

To recreate the iconic danmaku battles of Touhou Project as a card game, Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend features more than 200 different danmaku effects.
